name: Customer Statement
title: Customer Statement
description: Everything one customer ordered: details, a chart of their spending and every order with its lines.

parameters.name: customer
parameters.label: Customer
parameters.optionsSql: SELECT id, name FROM customers ORDER BY name

datasets.name: info
datasets.sql: SELECT c.name, c.city, c.country, c.region, c.segment, c.industry, c.customer_since, c.contact, c.credit_limit, e.name AS rep FROM customers c LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.id = c.rep_id WHERE c.id = :customer

datasets.name: lines
datasets.sql: SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.order_date, o.status, o.channel, p.name AS product, i.quantity, i.unit_price, round(i.quantity * i.unit_price * (1 - o.discount), 2) AS amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id WHERE o.customer_id = :customer ORDER BY o.order_date, o.id, p.name

datasets.name: monthly
datasets.sql: SELECT month, round(sum(revenue)) AS revenue FROM sales WHERE customer_id = :customer GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

body.text: {{First(segment)}} customer in {{First(industry)}} since {{First(customer_since)}}   ·   contact {{First(contact)}}   ·   account manager {{First(rep)}}   ·   credit limit {{Format(First(credit_limit), "$#,##0")}}
